title: News & Media Intel
description: Find publications with SearXNG: choose sources, language and time range, explore topics and original articles.
empty: Enter a person, company or topic. Publications and their sources will appear here.

filters.title: Search settings
filters.enginesHelp: Sources enabled on the server are used by default. Selecting sources limits searches to those that support the selected category.
filters.filterHelp: Language, time range and safe search support varies by source. The page limit controls sample size.

coverage.sampleHelp: Results describe the retrieved sample. They do not measure total publications or visits.

reasons.max_pages: The selected page limit was reached.
reasons.page_limit: The selected page limit was reached.
reasons.empty_results: The next page has no results.
reasons.empty_page: The next page has no results.
reasons.no_new_results: The next page repeats previously retrieved results.
reasons.duplicate_page: The next page repeats previously retrieved results.
reasons.request_failed: Not all pages could be loaded.
reasons.unavailable: Category results could not be retrieved.
reasons.other: Search stopped before all selected pages were retrieved.
reasons.exhausted: The sources returned no further results.
reasons.deadline: The search time limit was reached.
reasons.connection_error: The connection failed before all pages were loaded.
reasons.http_error: The search server could not load all pages.
reasons.invalid_response: Part of the search server response could not be read.
reasons.repeated_page: The next page repeats previously retrieved results.
reasons.result_limit: The publication sample limit was reached.

reasons.no_selected_engines: The selected sources do not support this category.

timeline.title: Publications by date
timeline.none: No publications with a known date were found.
timeline.undated: Unknown publication date: {count}. These items are excluded from the timeline.

mentions.title: Original sources
mentions.none: No public publications were found. Try a broader query, different time range or sources.

analytics.title: SEO and marketing analytics
analytics.description: Compare brand mentions, discover content topics and check your website's presence in search results.
analytics.empty: Enter a topic or search query. Add a brand and competitors to compare mentions, and a domain to check website presence.
analytics.competitorsHelp: Up to three names, one per line. Use names that appear in publications.
analytics.domainHelp: A domain or website URL, such as example.com. Subdomains are included.
analytics.sampleHelp: Analytics uses news and web results for one query with the same filters. Brands are compared within this sample.
analytics.partialHelp: Some sources or pages are unavailable. Metrics use retrieved results and comparisons may be incomplete.
analytics.reportExpiry: Snapshot available until {date}. Downloads use the completed report without repeating searches.
analytics.freshnessHelp: Known dates: {known}; within the past 7 days: {fresh}. The percentage uses known dates. Future dates ({future}) are excluded from freshness calculations.
analytics.brandsHelp: Mentions match a name in titles and snippets. Shares use matches of all selected brands. Sentiment is estimated from words and requires reviewing the original source.
analytics.noBrands: Add a brand or competitors to compare their mentions.
analytics.coMentions: Name matches: {matches}. Publications mentioning multiple brands: {count}; one publication can count toward several brands.
analytics.visibilityHelp: Positions refer to the combined web results retrieved from SearXNG. They describe this sample rather than rankings in an individual search engine. An absent website may still be indexed.
analytics.noDomain: Enter a domain to see its pages found in the sample.
analytics.visibilityUnavailable: Web search is unavailable. Domain presence has not been checked; try running the analysis again later.
analytics.domainNotFound: No domain pages were found in the retrieved sample.
analytics.contentHelp: Phrases and questions come from titles, snippets and search suggestions. Frequency counts sample matches and does not measure search demand.
analytics.noTopics: There is not enough text to extract topics.
analytics.noQuestions: No questions were found in the retrieved text and suggestions.
analytics.publishersHelp: Distribution of retrieved publications by domain. Use it to find relevant publishers and explore coverage; website traffic and authority are not measured.
analytics.noPublishers: There are no publishers or websites in this sample.

opportunities.topic_coverage: Explore “{topic}”: it appears in {documents} sample publications.
opportunities.answer_question: Prepare an answer to “{question}”. Matches found: {documents}.
opportunities.brand_presence: “{brand}” is not mentioned in this sample of {sampleSize} publications. Check the name spelling and topic coverage.
opportunities.publisher_outreach: Explore {host}: {documents} publications about the topic were found. Check its relevance before seeking placement.

errors.queryRequired: Enter a query of 2 to 180 characters.
errors.lookupFailed: Could not load news and analytics. Check the query and try again.
errors.optionsFailed: Could not load the available search sources.
errors.competitorLimit: Enter up to three competitors. Brand and competitor names must contain 2 to 80 characters.
errors.duplicateCompetitors: Brand and competitor names must be different.
errors.invalidDomain: Enter a domain or website URL without credentials or port, such as example.com.

help.label: About this module
help.overview: SearXNG combines public results from different sources. Choose categories, language, time range and search depth. Snippets are used to extract topics and estimate sentiment.
help.topics: Topics are extracted from titles and snippets. Counts describe the retrieved sample and do not measure a topic's popularity on the internet.
help.timeline: The timeline groups publications by known date. Undated items are excluded, and gaps do not imply that no publications exist.
help.mentions: Publications are merged by URL. Each card shows the publisher, known date and search sources that returned the result.
